svg.title: SCER-AVGZSL architecture
svg.desc: Source-faithful combined framework with DSPC class embedding optimization, SGTG Gaussian experts, and DMIF intra/inter masked attention and three-way gating.
svg.text: shared time axis; no audio-visual fusion in encoding
S_c^v and S_c^a provide separate K,V
① DSPC · Discriminative Semantic Prototype Calibration
text-side optimization over C_s ∪ C_u; no audio-visual samples
semantic topology retained · nearest classes separated
The prototype is optimized once, then frozen during main-network training.
② SGTG · Semantic-Guided Gaussian Temporal Grounding
the same structure runs independently for m = v and m = a
independent θ^v and θ^a allow different centers, widths, and routes
③ DMIF · Decoupled Modality Interaction and Gated Fusion
u^b reads A and V; modality tokens cannot read u^b
